title: Flexible Microneedle Platform for Synergistic Chemo/Photothermal Ferroptosis Therapy via P-Glycoprotein Inhibition in Breast Cancer.
abstract: Combining photothermal therapy (PTT) with chemotherapy shows promise for cancer treatment, but its efficacy is limited by heat shock protein (HSP)-induced thermoresistance and P-glycoprotein (P-gp)-mediated drug efflux. To overcome these challenges, we developed a tumor microenvironment-responsive microneedle platform for synergistic chemotherapy, PTT, and ferroptosis in breast cancer. The system employs Fe
